private_path_resolution: All relative private_inventory paths resolve against this exact physical private_root, never against another audit root. Extracted archive nested audit paths are archival members under private_root.
script_scope: Substantive preserved executed control and authentication scripts, copied legacy scripts, and every packaged source script are pinned in private_inventory. Source extraction/download/render and subprocess orchestration also used transparent inline Python/tool invocations; result files and every resulting byte stream are pinned. No claim that the source bodies of uninspected literature were read.
self_hash_rule: Receipt excluded from its own inventory; detached SHA256 authenticates it.
scope_limit: Internal AI supplied-candidate review, no external human/formal/novelty/openness certificate. Optional private-body custody is outside offline verification.
